Technical Data

Entity Type                                                                Service Operation

Release State                                                             released

Technical Name                                                      ContractAccountERPSplitltemGroupByBusinessPartnerlDQueryResponse_In
Namespace                                                               http://sap.com/xi/FICA/Global rie
Application Component                                                FI-CA

Web Service Definition (Back End)                                 ECC_CONTACC_SP_ITEM_GRP_BYBPQR
Direction                                                                        inbound

Mode                                                                             synchronous

Idempotency                                                                   no

Change/Update Behavior                                               not applicable

P2P Communication Enabled                                         true

Business Context and Use

The inbound operation Find Contract Account Split Item Group by Business Partner ID returns the items of one or more
contract accounts of a business partner according to specified selection criteria. The items are grouped with reference to the
original invoice.

See the Features section for a description of the available selection criteria and the returned fields.

Related Operations

The inbound operations Find Contract Account Receivables Payables Register Item by ID and Find Contract Account Split Item
Group by Elements return the items of a contract account based on other selection criteria.

You can use the operation Create Payment Directive to assign Splititems to a PaymentDirective and thus release them for
collection by the corresponding payment run. The released SplitItems are grouped together if they are set to be paid by the same

payment method.

Features

This operation returns the Items and Splitltems of a contract account for a specified business partner. Each Item, comprising one
or more Splitltems, may be open or cleared, or may contain a combination of open and cleared (subordinate) Splititems.

The corresponding data elements in SAP S/4HANA are:

e Items: OPBEL + OPUPW + OPUPK

e Splitltems: OPUPZ
